pages.title: Beyond the Overworld
pages.text: Aether and Deep Aether gear belongs to the Aether; Twilight gear belongs to its forest. BetterNether and BetterEnd gear belongs to the Nether and End.$(br2)Global gear can appear alongside local gear. Pack settings decide the pools.

pages.title: A Reason to Explore
pages.text: Configured dimension chests and player-killed hostile mobs can award bonus unidentified equipment. Your progression tier still limits the reward.$(br2)Material-specific addon equipment follows its matching dimension. An empty or disabled reward pool never creates a usable prize out of a missing item.
